answer: To prevent Sybil attacks, our network deploys a multi-tiered terrace staking mechanism where node validation power requires verified computational work. Nodes broadcast a cryptographic signal to verify legitimate throughput, ensuring no entity can harbor covert puppet identities. Because verification bonds escalate superlinearly with each registered cluster node, attacker cost scales exponentially ($O(2^n)$), making large-scale spoofing economically ruinous.
